# jenkins — 2020 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 235 jenkins CVEs of 2020 are in `data/cve/vendors/jenkins/2020.jsonl`.

### CVE-2020-2096
- Assigner: jenkins | Published: 2020-01-15 | Updated: 2024-08-04 | Max CVSS: None
- Exploit-DB 47927: Jenkins Gitlab Hook Plugin 1.4.2 - Reflected Cross-Site Scripting (webapps/java, 2020-01-16, verified=0)

Jenkins Gitlab Hook Plugin 1.4.2 and earlier does not escape project names in the build_now endpoint, resulting in a reflected XSS vulnerability.

Affected:
- Jenkins project / Jenkins Gitlab Hook Plugin: affected unspecified <=1.4.2 (custom); unknown next of 1.4.2 <unspecified (custom)

References:
- https://jenkins.io/security/advisory/2020-01-15/#SECURITY-1683 [x_refsource_CONFIRM]
- http://www.openwall.com/lists/oss-security/2020/01/15/1 [mailing-list,x_refsource_MLIST]
- http://packetstormsecurity.com/files/155967/Jenkins-Gitlab-Hook-1.4.2-Cross-Site-Scripting.html [x_refsource_MISC]

### CVE-2020-2229
- Assigner: jenkins | Published: 2020-08-12 | Updated: 2024-08-04 | Max CVSS: None
- Exploit-DB 49232: Jenkins 2.235.3 - 'tooltip' Stored Cross-Site Scripting (webapps/java, 2020-12-11, verified=0)

Jenkins 2.251 and earlier, LTS 2.235.3 and earlier does not escape the tooltip content of help icons, resulting in a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability.

Affected:
- Jenkins project / Jenkins: affected unspecified <=2.251 (custom); affected unspecified <=LTS 2.235.3 (custom)

### CVE-2020-2230
- Assigner: jenkins | Published: 2020-08-12 | Updated: 2024-08-04 | Max CVSS: None
- Exploit-DB 49237: Jenkins 2.235.3 - 'Description' Stored XSS (webapps/java, 2020-12-11, verified=0)

Jenkins 2.251 and earlier, LTS 2.235.3 and earlier does not escape the project naming strategy description, resulting in a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exploitable by users with Overall/Manage permission.

Affected:
- Jenkins project / Jenkins: affected unspecified <=2.251 (custom); affected unspecified <=LTS 2.235.3 (custom)

References:

### CVE-2020-2231
- Assigner: jenkins | Published: 2020-08-12 | Updated: 2024-08-04 | Max CVSS: None
- Exploit-DB 49244: Jenkins 2.235.3 - 'X-Forwarded-For' Stored XSS (webapps/java, 2020-12-14, verified=0)

Jenkins 2.251 and earlier, LTS 2.235.3 and earlier does not escape the remote address of the host starting a build via 'Trigger builds remotely', resulting in a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exploitable by users with Job/Configure permission or knowledge of the Authentication Token.

Affected:
- Jenkins project / Jenkins: affected unspecified <=2.251 (custom); affected unspecified <=LTS 2.235.3 (custom)
